desc: Derive the O(NK) algorithm using ordered-tuple inclusion-exclusion.
Implement the algorithm in Python with O(NK) time and O(NK) memory, handling prefix sums, suffix tables S_e and S'_e, binomial coefficients, and the final summation.
Review the existing implementation for correctness, especially the definitions of suffix sums, the inclusion–exclusion signs, and the handling of indices when l-1 = 0 or r-1 < l.
Test the corrected implementation on the three provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Run additional small random tests comparing the fast algorithm against a brute-force O(N^2) reference to ensure correctness.
Ensure proper handling of negative contributions and the modulus 998244353 throughout.
